title: The Hodge Conjecture: Millennium Prize Problem
content:
**The Hodge Conjecture**:

> Every **Hodge class** on a smooth projective variety is a rational linear combination of **algebraic cycle** classes.

**Formally**: For X smooth projective over ℂ:
$$H^{p,p}(X) \cap H^{2p}(X, \mathbb{Q}) = \mathbb{Q}\text{-span of } \{\text{cl}(Z) : Z \text{ algebraic}\}$$

**Status: OPEN** — One of 7 Millennium Prize Problems ($1,000,000)

**Essence**: Bridges topology (cohomology) and algebra (subvarieties).
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of the hodge conjecture: millennium prize problem

title: Pure Hodge Structures with Complexification
content:
**Pure Hodge Structure of weight k** (enhanced):

- A ℚ-vector space V_ℚ
- Complexification V_ℂ with **explicit map** ι : V_ℚ →ₗ[ℚ] V_ℂ
- **Injectivity**: ι is injective (rational lattice embeds faithfully)
- **Hodge decomposition**: $V_{\mathbb{C}} = \bigoplus_{p+q=k} V^{p,q}$

**Key improvement**: The complexification map ι makes the connection between rational classes and the complex decomposition explicit and rigorous.

**Origin**: Arises from cohomology of compact Kähler manifolds.

title: Hodge Numbers and Hodge Symmetry (PROVED)
content:
**Hodge Numbers**: $h^{p,q} = \dim_{\mathbb{C}} V^{p,q}$

**Hodge Symmetry** (proved from conjugation axiom):
$$h^{p,q} = h^{q,p}$$

This means the **Hodge diamond** is symmetric about its vertical axis.

**Proof**: Direct consequence of the axiom that complex conjugation maps V^{p,q} isomorphically to V^{q,p}, preserving dimension.

This is one of the few properties we can **prove** rather than axiomatize!

title: Hodge Filtration
content:
**Hodge Filtration**: Decreasing filtration $F^p$ on $V_{\mathbb{C}}$:
$$F^p = \bigoplus_{i \geq p} V^{i,k-i}$$

Satisfies:
- $F^0 = V_{\mathbb{C}}$ (full space)
- $F^{k+1} = 0$ (terminates)
- $F^{p+1} \subseteq F^p$ (decreasing)

**Recovery**: $V^{p,q} = F^p \cap \overline{F^q}$

The filtration viewpoint is essential for studying **variations of Hodge structure** as the variety deforms.

title: Hodge Classes (Strengthened)
content:
**Hodge Class** (enhanced definition):

A rational class v ∈ V_ℚ such that its **complexification** ι(v) lies in V^{p,p}:
$$v \in V_{\mathbb{Q}} \text{ with } \iota(v) \in V^{p,p}$$

**Key improvement**: The membership condition uses the actual complexification map ι, not a placeholder `True`. This connects the rational lattice to the complex decomposition rigorously.

**These are the classes the conjecture claims are algebraic!**

title: Cycle Classes are Hodge Classes
content:
**Key Property**: Every algebraic cycle class is a Hodge class.

The cycle class map cl : Z^p(X) → H^{2p}(X, ℚ) satisfies:
$$\iota(\text{cl}(Z)) \in V^{p,p}$$

This means algebraic classes are *always* Hodge classes. The Hodge Conjecture asks the **converse**: are all Hodge classes algebraic?

The function `cycleToHodgeClass` constructs a `HodgeClass` from any `AlgebraicCycle`.

title: The Hodge Conjecture Statement
content:
**THE HODGE CONJECTURE**:

For any smooth projective variety X over ℂ and any p ∈ ℕ:

$$\forall \alpha \in H^{p,p}(X) \cap H^{2p}(X, \mathbb{Q}): \exists Z_1, \ldots, Z_n, a_1, \ldots, a_n$$
$$\alpha = \sum_i a_i \cdot \text{cl}(Z_i)$$

where Zᵢ are algebraic cycles of codimension p and aᵢ ∈ ℚ.

**Status**: OPEN since 1950. Resolving this earns a $1M Millennium Prize!
mathContext: Hodge class = ℚ-linear combo of algebraic classes

title: Lefschetz (1,1) Theorem (PROVEN)
content:
**Lefschetz (1,1) Theorem (1924)**:

For ANY smooth projective variety X, every integral Hodge class of type (1,1) is algebraic:
$$H^{1,1}(X) \cap H^2(X, \mathbb{Z}) = \text{Pic}(X) \otimes \mathbb{Z}$$

**Key**: Such classes are first Chern classes of line bundles (= divisor classes).

**Proof idea**: Uses the exponential sequence:
$$0 \to \mathbb{Z} \to \mathcal{O}_X \to \mathcal{O}_X^* \to 0$$

This is the **only proven case** for general varieties!

title: Hodge Conjecture for Curves and Surfaces (PROVEN)
content:
**Proven Cases**:

**Curves (dim = 1)**:
- H^2(X) = ℚ, generated by [X]
- Trivially algebraic ✓

**Surfaces (dim = 2)**:
- p = 0: H⁰ = ℚ·1 (constant functions) ✓
- p = 1: Lefschetz (1,1) theorem ✓
- p = 2: H⁴ = ℚ·[point] (point class) ✓

**Formalized**: `hodge_conjecture_surfaces` proves all surface cases!

title: Integral Hodge Conjecture and Its Failure
content:
**Integral vs Rational Hodge Conjecture**:

**Integral version**: Every Hodge class is an **integer** linear combination of cycle classes.
**Rational version**: Every Hodge class is a **rational** linear combination.

**Atiyah-Hirzebruch (1962)**: Integral version is FALSE!
- Uses torsion in cohomology and Steenrod operations
- Later simplified by Totaro (1997)

**Proved theorem**: `integral_implies_rational`
- If integral version holds, rational version follows
- Since integral version fails, the two are genuinely different

This justifies why the Hodge Conjecture specifically uses ℚ coefficients.
mathContext: ℤ-Hodge ⟹ ℚ-Hodge, but ℤ-Hodge is false

title: Voisin's Kähler Counterexample
content:
**Voisin (2002)**: Hodge Conjecture fails for Kähler manifolds!

- Constructed a complex torus (Kähler but not projective)
- Has Hodge classes that are NOT rational combinations of analytic subvariety classes
- Shows **projectivity is essential**

The Hodge Conjecture is very precise in its hypotheses:
- Must be projective (not just Kähler)
- Must use rational coefficients (not integral)
- Must be over ℂ (not other fields)

title: Related Conjectures
content:
**Web of Conjectures**:

**Grothendieck's Standard Conjectures** (1968):
- (B) Lefschetz: Lefschetz operator is algebraic
- (C) Künneth: projectors are algebraic
- (D) Hodge: intersection pairing positive on primitives
- **Imply Hodge Conjecture!**

**Mumford-Tate Conjecture**:
- Relates Hodge structure to Galois action on abelian varieties
- **Hodge ⟹ Mumford-Tate** (proved as implication)

All remain open and deeply connected!
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of related conjectures

title: Structural Properties: Serre Duality and Additivity
content:
**Serre Duality for Hodge Numbers**:
$$h^{p,q} = h^{n-p,n-q}$$

Combined with Hodge symmetry $h^{p,q} = h^{q,p}$, this gives the **full dihedral symmetry** of the Hodge diamond (group of order 4).

**Cycle Class Map Additivity**:
$$\text{cl}(Z_1 + Z_2) = \text{cl}(Z_1) + \text{cl}(Z_2)$$

This ensures the image of the cycle class map forms a ℚ-subspace of Hodge classes.

title: Problem Status: OPEN
content:
**Hodge Conjecture: Still OPEN since 1950**

**PROVEN cases**:
- Curves (trivial) ✓
- Surfaces (Lefschetz + dimension) ✓
- Divisors on any variety (Lefschetz 1,1) ✓
- Special abelian varieties (Deligne) ✓

**PROVED properties**:
- Hodge symmetry h^{p,q} = h^{q,p} ✓
- Integral ⟹ rational ✓

**FAILS for**:
- Kähler manifolds (must be projective)
- Integral coefficients (must use ℚ)

**Prize**: $1,000,000 Millennium Prize awaits!
mathContext: See annotation content for formal details of problem status: open

title: Absolute Hodge Classes: Deligne's Evidence for the Conjecture
content: Deligne introduced the notion of absolute Hodge classes: those Hodge classes $\alpha \in H^{p,p}(X) \cap H^{2p}(X, \mathbb{Q})$ that remain Hodge under all automorphisms $\sigma \in \text{Aut}(\mathbb{C}/\mathbb{Q})$. This is a strictly stronger condition than being Hodge. Deligne proved that for abelian varieties, every Hodge class is absolute Hodge — powerful evidence for the Hodge Conjecture since all known algebraic classes are absolute Hodge. However, absolute Hodge $\ne$ algebraic in general; there is no known way to construct the algebraic cycle from the absolute Hodge property. The formalization axiomatizes the absolute Hodge condition and Deligne's theorem for abelian varieties.
mathContext: Absolute Hodge: $\alpha$ remains in $H^{p,p}(X^\sigma)$ for all $\sigma \in \text{Aut}(\mathbb{C}/\mathbb{Q})$; algebraic $\implies$ absolute Hodge $\implies$ Hodge; for abelian varieties: absolute Hodge = Hodge (Deligne)

title: The Tate Conjecture: p-adic Analogue of the Hodge Conjecture
content: The Tate Conjecture is the arithmetic analogue of the Hodge Conjecture, replacing complex Hodge theory with $\ell$-adic cohomology over finite fields. For a smooth projective variety $X$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$, the conjecture asserts that the cycle class map $\text{CH}^p(X) \otimes \mathbb{Q}_\ell \to H^{2p}_{\text{ét}}(X, \mathbb{Q}_\ell(p))^{G_{\mathbb{F}_q}}$ is surjective onto Galois-invariant classes. Tate proved it for divisors on abelian varieties over finite fields; Faltings proved it for divisors on all abelian varieties over number fields. The Hodge-Tate comparison theorem $H^n_{\text{dR}}(X/K) \otimes_K \mathbb{C}_p \cong \bigoplus_{p+q=n} H^q(X, \Omega^p_X) \otimes_K \mathbb{C}_p(p)$ connects the two worlds. The formalization axiomatizes the Tate conjecture and its relationship to the Hodge conjecture via comparison theorems.
mathContext: Tate: $\text{CH}^p(X) \otimes \mathbb{Q}_\ell \twoheadrightarrow H^{2p}(X, \mathbb{Q}_\ell(p))^{\text{Gal}}$; proved for divisors on abelian varieties (Tate, Faltings)

title: Homological Mirror Symmetry and the Hodge Conjecture
content: Kontsevich's homological mirror symmetry (HMS, 1994) proposes an equivalence $D^b(\text{Coh}(X)) \cong D^b(\text{Fuk}(\check{X}))$ between the derived category of coherent sheaves on $X$ and the Fukaya category of its mirror $\check{X}$. Under mirror symmetry, Hodge classes on $X$ correspond to Lagrangian submanifolds of $\check{X}$ — objects with a natural geometric/algebraic structure. This suggests a physical approach to the Hodge Conjecture: if mirror symmetry can produce the algebraic cycle from the Lagrangian. The formalization covers Fourier-Mukai transforms (which preserve Hodge structures), Bridgeland stability conditions, and the mirror of a Hodge class. The non-abelian Hodge correspondence (Simpson) provides an independent bridge between topology (flat connections) and algebraic geometry (Higgs bundles).
mathContext: HMS: $D^b(\text{Coh}(X)) \cong D^b(\text{Fuk}(\check{X}))$; Hodge class $\leftrightarrow$ Lagrangian; Fourier-Mukai preserves Hodge structure
